name: Campus Main Powerhouse & Substation
description: Central campus electrical HT substation with backup diesel generators, auto-synchronization panels, and solar grid tie-in.

name: Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) & Water Recycling
description: Biological STP recycling campus greywater for sports field irrigation and botanical landscape maintenance.

name: Sri Krishna Campus Temple
description: Campus temple dedicated to Lord Krishna near BK Pudur main entrance gate, surrounded by flowering gardens.

name: AICTE-IDEA Lab
description: AICTE sponsored Innovation, Design, Enterprising and Apprenticeship (IDEA) Lab with 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC, and IoT workstations.

name: Axis Bank & 24/7 ATM Facility
description: Full-service banking branch and 24/7 ATM kiosk located adjacent to campus main gate for students and faculty.

name: Campus Medical Health Centre
description: On-campus primary healthcare dispensary with resident medical officer, emergency care bed, and ambulance bay.
